QF.id: IV Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_25

question.text: The Investor Protection Fund can be used to compensate investors who suffer losses due to:

explanation.text: The Logic: The Investor Protection Fund (IPF) is used to settle legitimate investment claims of clients of a defaulting trading member. It does not protect against market losses, wrong investment choices, or currency movements. The Trap: Market decline and currency depreciation are market risks, not broker default. Losses on wrong investment decisions are also not within IPF scope; the fund addresses default of a registered trading member specifically.
